dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Grandma, may I ask you a question? Nawaz and I have been thinking about this one, but we still don't get it.

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Oh, of course you can, dear.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: So, uh... Grandma, is King Deshret really gonna come back from the dead...?

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Those fanatic believers! Can't they spare the children!?

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Child, please, listen well. Though gods are indeed very powerful, even they can disappear.

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Being obsessed with things that have disappeared is madness. It is no way to live.

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only the desert children had the chance to learn a little more. Then they wouldn't easily fall for such lies...

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Child, I... I know this is a lot to ask, but please, study hard — you should learn a thing or two from Setaria.
